references.text: The Israelites' departure from Egypt with approximately 600,000 men on foot, which corresponds to the census in Numbers
The census of men at the construction of the tabernacle shows the same number: 603,550
Repeats the total number of the registered Israelites: 603,550
Moses mentions 600,000 foot soldiers whom he leads and confirms the population count
The second census in Numbers, showing a similar number: 601,730
